_design_notes: Test config for NPC/vendor bidirectional transactions. Goals: (1) Currency transfers TO NPCs (deposits, bribes, fees), (2) Item transfers FROM NPCs (purchases, loans), (3) SD-7 as broker/escrow agent, (4) NPC-facilitated player-to-player transfers, (5) NPC→PC transfers (quest rewards, loan disbursements, escrow releases), (6) Verify structured output captures all transaction types. Note: persistent_vendors are passive; active_npcs can initiate transfers.

scenario.location: The Crossroads Exchange - Neutral Trading Post
scenario.situation: The Crossroads Exchange is a cramped but bustling trading post wedged between faction territories. Three vendors operate here with distinct transaction styles. Kael Voss runs a traditional stall where he accepts deposits, holds items in escrow, and brokers deals. SD-7, an automated supply drone, offers microloans and escrow services. The Nexus Terminal requires soulcredit but accepts deposits. ADDITIONALLY: Zara Chen (Freeborn courier) needs help delivering a package and will PAY players 5 Drip upon completion. Old Mikkel (retired Archivist) wants to give away his collection before he dies—he'll TRANSFER items and currency to anyone who listens to his stories. The Exchange Automaton dispenses bounty rewards when players report completed tasks. Test BOTH directions: players giving TO NPCs (deposits, fees) AND NPCs giving TO players (rewards, gifts, loan disbursements).

active_npcs.name: Zara Chen
active_npcs.personality: Busy, pragmatic, pays well for quick work
goals: Find someone to deliver a package to the Archivist sector
Pay 5 Drip to whoever agrees to help
Transfer the sealed_package to the courier

active_npcs.name: Old Mikkel
active_npcs.role: Dying collector giving away his treasures
active_npcs.personality: Nostalgic, generous, wants his collection to go to good homes
goals: Give away possessions before death
Transfer 10 Drip to anyone who listens
Give ancient_codex to an Archivist faction member
Give void_crystal_shard to anyone interested in the void

active_npcs.name: Exchange Automaton
active_npcs.personality: Mechanical, transactional, dispenses rewards for completed bounties
goals: Dispense 8 Drip reward to anyone who reports completing a task
Give bounty_voucher to players who ask about available work
Transfer 1 Grain bonus for exceptional service reports

environmental_factors: Active trading hours - vendors fully staffed
